CellMatch.description: Cell test: * anything, + any value, . empty, slug = that value or group, !slug = not that value or group, [a|b] = any of the members, ![a|b] = none of them (members: ., + or slugs).

Checker.description: Checkerboard spacing: skip every other cell along an axis, alternating per line.

Legend.description: Glyph to cell test, or the name of a legend in rules/macros.json.

Modulo.description:
Only cells where `(x - x_offset) % x == 0` and `(y - y_offset) % y == 0`,
counted from the level origin.

OutOfBounds.description: "." for empty, or an IntGrid value slug.

Pattern.description: A rectangular grid pattern, anchored at its `@` cell, else its center.

grid.description: The int_grid layer to read. Default: the auto layer's `source`.

legend.description:
Glyph to cell test, for glyphs that don't mean what they mean by
default (see [`Pattern::resolve`]); or the name of a legend in
`rules/macros.json`.

rows.description:
Rows of glyphs, top first; or the name of a pattern in
`rules/macros.json`. The anchor is the `@` cell, else the center
(then width and height must be odd).

Perlin.description:
Perlin noise gate: the rule only fires where noise is positive.
Kept when inactive so an LDtk import is lossless.

Require.description: Patterns that must also hold, anchored on the same cell: one pattern, or a non-empty array (all must hold).

Rows.description: Rows of glyphs, top first, or the name of a pattern in rules/macros.json.

Slug.description: snake_case name: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or underscores.

oneOf.description: Also try the pattern flipped left-right; output tiles are flipped to match.
Also try the pattern flipped top-bottom.

Also try the three 90-degree rotations; with a mirror, all eight
orientations. Needs square tiles.

Template.description:
A template in `rules/macros.json`: rules whose tiles are relative to a
reference's `origin` and whose tileset comes from the reference.

doc.description: What it draws and how its tiles are laid out.

legend.description:
Default legend for every rule (an object, or a name in `legends`);
a rule's own `match.legend` entries win.

name.description: Display name, for the editor's template library.

rules.description: The rules, in evaluation order. Slugs are unique within the template.

TemplateOutput.description: What a template rule draws: tiles (tileset optional: the reference's), or stamp.

avoid_overlap.description: Skip a placement whose footprint has an occupied cell. Default false.

pivot.description: With `tile_mode: stamp`: anchor inside the alternative's box. Default `[0, 0]`.

tiles.description: Alternatives; one is picked per cell by weight (with `tileset`).

avoid_overlap.description: Skip a placement whose footprint has an occupied cell. Default false.

stamp.description: A stamp slug from this file's `stamps` (instead of `tileset` + `tiles`).

TemplateRule.description:
A rule inside a template: a pattern [`Rule`] that draws, whose
`out.tileset` may be left out (it comes from the reference). Tile
coordinates of a rule without its own `out.tileset` are relative to the
reference's `origin`; a rule that names its own tileset is *fixed*:
absolute coordinates, its own tileset. Region rules and `write` outputs
can't be in a template (a load error).

break.description: After this rule draws a cell, later rules skip that cell.

chance.description: Probability 0 to 1 that a matching cell is drawn. Default 1.

out_of_bounds.description: What pattern cells outside the level read as.

require.description:
Patterns that must also hold, anchored on the same cell (one, or a
list).

salt.description: Extra integer mixed into this rule's random choices. Default 0.

slug.description: Unique within the template. The expanded rule is `<reference slug>__<slug>`.

symmetry.description: Extra mirrored or rotated variants of the pattern to try.

TileAlt.description: Tile alternative: [col, row], [col, row, w, h], { "rect": [col, row, w, h], "weight": n } or { "stack": [[col, row], ...], "weight": n }.

TileMode.description: How the chosen alternative's tiles are laid out.

oneOf.description:
Every tile of the alternative is drawn at the matching cell, stacked
in list order (normally an alternative is one tile).

The alternative's tiles keep their atlas layout, scaled by the
tileset's tile size and positioned by `pivot` (LDtk "stamp").

description:
Shared pattern pieces and templates: `rules/macros.json` (optional).
Rules refer to them by name: `match.rows` / `require.rows` to
`patterns`, `match.legend` / `require.legend` to `legends`, and
`{ "use": ... }` entries to `templates` (or a built-in, see
[`Macros::builtin_templates`]).

templates.description:
Named templates: parameterized lists of rules that a group uses with
`{ "use": "<name>", ... }`.
